say:1:1130817001:0.text: Since you've made it all the way here, I'll tell you everything!
say:1:1130817001:0.source_cn: 你能找到这里也不容易，那好吧，我告诉你！
say:1:1130817001:0.male: Since you've made it all the way here, I'll tell you everything!
say:1:1130817001:0.female: Since you've made it all the way here, I'll tell you everything!

say:2:1130817002:0.text: Those Quicksand Claws have no idea that their spoils from the caravans and Mauler clans are being stolen at night.
say:2:1130817002:0.source_cn: 流沙之爪肯定想不到，他们白天在外面抢劫商队和蛮血部族，...
say:2:1130817002:0.male: Those Quicksand Claws have no idea that their spoils from the caravans and Mauler clans are being stolen at night.
say:2:1130817002:0.female: Those Quicksand Claws have no idea that their spoils from the caravans and Mauler clans are being stolen at night.

say:3:1130817003:1.text: ...By me! I send out the stolen goods before daybreak and get my friends to sell them at the market in Alkali.
say:3:1130817003:1.source_cn: ——就是我啦！我趁着天亮之前把偷来的东西送出去，委托朋...
say:3:1130817003:1.male: ...By me! I send out the stolen goods before daybreak and get my friends to sell them at the market in Alkali.
say:3:1130817003:1.female: ...By me! I send out the stolen goods before daybreak and get my friends to sell them at the market in Alkali.

say:4:1130817004:1.text: The money's great—way better than risking my life for bounties and missing meals all the time!
say:4:1130817004:1.source_cn: 一晚上就能赚不少呢！比以前辛辛苦苦接悬赏，三天吃两顿的...
say:4:1130817004:1.male: The money's great—way better than risking my life for bounties and missing meals all the time!
say:4:1130817004:1.female: The money's great—way better than risking my life for bounties and missing meals all the time!

say:5:1130817005:1.text: I've been here for a while. Those stupid Claws didn't think anyone would have the salt to sneak in here.
say:5:1130817005:1.source_cn: 我已经在这里生活好久了，流沙之爪那些傻子以为没人敢潜入...
say:5:1130817005:1.male: I've been here for a while. Those stupid Claws didn't think anyone would have the salt to sneak in here.
say:5:1130817005:1.female: I've been here for a while. Those stupid Claws didn't think anyone would have the salt to sneak in here.

say:6:1130817006:1.text: Well, it's not for every bounty hunter.
say:6:1130817006:1.source_cn: 当然，也不是每个赏金猎人都能做这生意的。
say:6:1130817006:1.male: Well, it's not for every bounty hunter.
say:6:1130817006:1.female: Well, it's not for every bounty hunter.

say:7:1130817007:1.text: You gotta be super agile and stealthy like me!
say:7:1130817007:1.source_cn: 得像我这样行动敏捷，懂得隐蔽行踪的厉害赏金猎人才行！
say:7:1130817007:1.male: You gotta be super agile and stealthy like me!
say:7:1130817007:1.female: You gotta be super agile and stealthy like me!
